release_notes: Geo databases work out of the box. The installer downloads the free Sypex Geo City database (country/region/city) during setup and a monthly cron keeps it fresh. Existing installs get it automatically: the panel updater, after a successful update, downloads Sypex when no geo database is present. A banner on every tab explains when no database is installed, offers one-click Sypex install and links to the geo settings - so an empty country column no longer reads as broken cloaking. MaxMind and IP2Location/IP2Proxy databases update automatically too, but only when their account keys are saved in Settings. Downloads are non-fatal: a server that cannot reach sypexgeo.net installs fine and can add a database later.
